0: Grasp the tomato truss on the plate with the right hand and hold it securely.
1: Lift the tomato truss with the right hand, move it to the center between both hands, and hold it steady for the left hand to pick a tomato.
2: Pick a single cherry tomato from the truss held by the right hand using the left hand.
3: Place the picked cherry tomato into the plate on the left with the left hand.
